summary: Backend email-OTP auth + freelancer verify-email + complaints fully validated (10/10 pytest pass). Frontend freelancer wizard (step 2 'Verify Your Email', no Aadhaar, step 4 heading) works end-to-end including SEND OTP → OTP read from db.email_otps → VERIFY → email-verify-success. LOGIN screen (/) email OTP flow is BROKEN in the UI: tapping 'Continue with Email' shows 'Network error. Try again.' with ZERO API request emitted (CDP-verified). Same fetch pattern works from the wizard, so the failure is scoped to app/index.tsx requestOtp/verifyOtp. Google button + browse-first login still render OK; jobs-feed banner copy 'profile + email OTP' only appears in an unauthenticated freelancer state and could not be triggered via /freelancer/jobs during this run (redirected to landing) — needs a lightweight check by main agent.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping 'Continue with Email' (login-email-btn) never emits an HTTP request but sets 'Network error. Try again.' — fetch throws synchronously before hitting the network. Reproduced across 6 fresh sessions with unique emails. CDP Network domain confirms zero /api/auth/email/* requests are sent. Direct page.evaluate(fetch(...)) with the same URL/body succeeds (200) — so backend/CORS are fine and this is a client-side wiring bug in requestOtp (index.tsx:30-57). Same pattern in app/freelancer/index.tsx works.
verifyOtp is likely broken for the same reason (blocked before we could reach OTP entry). Please recheck after fixing requestOtp.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked at the very first step (request-otp) — no session can be minted through the UI even though backend works.

action_items: Debug app/index.tsx requestOtp: fetch throws synchronously on the login screen only. Suggested checks — (a) confirm BACKEND_URL resolves in this component tree (it does at page level), (b) verify the button isn't being unmounted mid-click (a parent effect might toggle pendingRole/user), (c) try replacing template literal with explicit string concatenation, (d) add a console.log at the start of requestOtp before setOtpLoading to see if the async function even progresses past state setters, (e) consider whether React 18 concurrent mode is bailing out. The freelancer wizard's sendVerifyOtp works with identical fetch code, so diff the surrounding hooks/state.

Verify the jobs-feed banner 'profile + email OTP' actually reaches the intended unauthenticated freelancer view (freelancer/jobs.tsx:494). During test, /freelancer/jobs redirected to landing; ensure this branch is reachable per spec.

Reproducer: goto /, tap I'M HIRING (or FREELANCER), enter any valid email, tap Continue with Email — expect 'Network error' with no CDP network activity. Read OTPs from Mongo (db.email_otps).
rca_of_issue: Login screen 'Continue with Email' — Root cause not fully isolated. Evidence: (1) 'Network error. Try again.' string is only set inside the catch of requestOtp/verifyOtp in app/index.tsx. (2) Playwright CDP Network capture shows ZERO /api/* requests initiated by the tap. (3) window/globalThis.fetch monkey-patch never fires (nor XHR). (4) Direct in-page fetch to the exact same URL succeeds with 200. (5) Identical fetch pattern in freelancer/index.tsx sendVerifyOtp works end-to-end. Hypothesis: something in the login screen render tree causes fetch to be called on an undefined/stale reference, or the async function throws before fetch (e.g., a hoisting/TDZ issue post-Metro-transform), and the empty catch (catch {}) hides the real error. Fix: expose the caught error to console and re-test to pinpoint the throw.
